selection_rules: Discover models from each provider using the credential already delivered by TV/TVC.
Never require a human to type a provider model ID into the consuming repository.
Filter discovered models by the requested capability class and policy allow/deny patterns.
Choose the highest-preference available route deterministically.
Record every discovered candidate, exclusion reason, selected route, policy hash, and resolution hash without recording credentials.
Fail closed when no eligible route exists for a required provider.
claim_boundary: This file governs route discovery and deterministic selection. It does not assert cross-provider capability equivalence, price equivalence, or outcome equivalence.
